# IV) CLASSIFICATION

## 2) SGD Classifier of Linear Model

The \textcolor{red}{SGD Classifier} is an algorithm of classification that is a part of the linear model module.

```{python}

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from sklearn.linear_model import SGDClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score, mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error
```

Here, we try to classify a type of flower though the \textcolor{blue}{iris} dataset.

```{python}

iris = load_iris()
y = iris.target
X = iris.data

modele = SGDClassifier(random_state = 0)
modele.fit(X,y)

y_pred = modele.predict(X)
R2_sc = r2_score(y, y_pred)
R2 = modele.score(X, y)

mse = mean_squared_error(y, y_pred)
rmse = mean_squared_error(y, y_pred, squared = False)
mae = mean_absolute_error(y, y_pred)

print(f"\nScore (Error in the prediction): {R2}")
print(f"Score (Error in the datasets): {R2_sc}\n")

print(f"MSE = {mse}")
print(f"RMSE = {rmse}")
print(f"MAE = {mae}")

plt.scatter(X[:,0], y, c = 'b', label = 'Real datasets')
plt.scatter(X[:,0], y_pred, c = 'r', label = 'Prediciton datasets')
plt.legend()
plt.show()
plt.close()
```
